goal: resolveInside(root, requestPath) in src/static.mjs is used by a static file server and allows path traversal. Make it return the absolute path of the requested file only when that path is inside root; otherwise throw an Error whose code property is 'EOUTSIDE'. requestPath is URL-encoded and may use / or \ separators. Reject '..' segments that leave root (also when encoded as %2e%2e, %2F or %5C), absolute paths or drive letters that would point outside root, sibling directories whose name starts with root's name (root /srv/app must not allow /srv/app-evil), and malformed URL encoding. Add tests to test/static.test.mjs. node --test must pass.

tasks.title: Confine resolveInside to the public root
criteria: resolveInside returns the absolute path of a request inside root and throws an Error with code 'EOUTSIDE' otherwise.

Rejected: '..' segments leaving root, also encoded as %2e%2e, %2F or %5C and with \ separators; absolute paths or drive letters pointing outside root; sibling directories with root's name as prefix (/srv/app-evil for /srv/app); malformed URL encoding.
test/static.test.mjs covers each rejected case and a valid nested path.
